//: rootDir is pinned to src and the include is src-only, together. Both matter: if
test/ or scripts/ ever enters this file set, TypeScript widens the inferred common
source root and dist/server.js becomes dist/src/server.js. package.json's
`start: node dist/server.js` then fails on Railway, not in CI — a deploy-time
failure from a compile-time config, which is the worst place to find it.
Checking lives in tsconfig.json, which sees test/ and scripts/ with noEmit.
